description:
Sweep the three sweepable seam fields through the standing crossover rule.

## Background

The proof-surface seam design (dev/active/7d7c647c/design.md) governs this task; read it in full. Its §3 fixes the three-part seam with probe-verified surface claims, §4 gives each field its name, kind, range, default-naming constant, mechanism and route-observation obligation, §5 records the decisions (D1 direct removal, D2 lane split, D3 opaque pin, D4 default naming, D5 public reporters, D6 source-level convention amendments), §6 enumerates the post-processing deletions, and §8 scopes the tasks. The follow-on migration design (dev/active/7d824b2f/design.md) supplies the shared field-kind, mechanism and test conventions.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The calibration action sweeps gemm.winograd_min_dim, triangular.base_case_max_dim and ple.scalar_base_max_cols, reusing the existing profile-steering mechanism.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each outcome is recorded in the calibration receipt; the two panel-lane fields stay omitted from committed profiles under the standing omission rule until a steering mechanism reaches the non-panel arm.
title: Extend the calibration sweep to the seam threshold fields
